page_title: PAR 0-2 UDI | Parma v Udinese 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Marco Piccinini has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

90+4' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Parma win a corner kick.
90+3' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Kosta Runjaic, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!

90+3' Adam Buksa (Udinese) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Parma are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Jakub Piotrowski will be replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
89' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 6:17.
87' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
87' Mathias Lovik (Parma) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
86' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Maduka Okoye.
85' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Nicolo Zaniolo and he is replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
82' Today's match ends for Alessandro Zanoli who will be replaced by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese).
81' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Emanuele Valeri is replaced by Mathias Lovik (Parma).
81' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the right post.
80' The resulting corner, taken by Emanuele Valeri (Parma), comes to nothing.
79' Here comes a substitution. Adrian Bernabe Garcia is given a rest as he is replaced by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
77' The resulting corner from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
76' That looked a certain handball by Lautaro Valenti (Parma) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
76' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) will deliver the corner kick.

76' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.

75' Adam Buksa (Udinese) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the top left corner, but Edoardo Corvi shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
73' Wasted opportunity! Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
71' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
70' The resulting corner from Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is cleared.

70' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
70' Foul! Jordan Zemura (Udinese) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Parma have a free kick.
69' The total number of attempts is 10:8. 2:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
68' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Adam Buksa (Udinese) replaces Keinan Davis.
68' Here comes a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Arthur Atta.
66' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
65' 0 - 2 Goal! Keinan Davis (Udinese) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Edoardo Corvi to commit before slotting the penalty into the top left corner.
65' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
64' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Mariano Troilo (Parma). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

62' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Mariano Troilo (Parma), but referee Marco Piccinini must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
62' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Mariano Troilo (Parma) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
62' Mariano Troilo (Parma) is penalised for holding. Marco Piccinini signals a set piece. A penalty is awarded to Udinese!

60' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Edoardo Corvi makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom right corner.

59' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post.
57' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) commits a foul and Marco Piccinini immediately signals a free kick.
56' A substitution has been made. Oliver Sorensen is replaced by Hernani (Parma).
55' Edoardo Corvi leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
54' Mariano Troilo (Parma) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
54' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
50' Marco Piccinini blows his whistle after Jordan Zemura (Udinese) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
49' A fine pass finds Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Maduka Okoye reacts superbly to deny him.
46' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Patrick Cutrone (Parma) comes off for Jacob Ondrejka.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Carlos Cuesta probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mandela Keita (Parma). He is replaced by Nahuel Estevez.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) attacks the corner from Arthur Atta in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
45+3' Arthur Atta (Udinese) prepares to take a corner kick.

45+2' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Piccinini signals. Parma have a free kick.
43' The resulting corner from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
42' Oumar Solet (Udinese) failed to beat Edoardo Corvi, who expertly stopped his header from the centre of the box towards the roof of the net after a rebound. Udinese get a corner.
42' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

42' Arthur Atta (Udinese) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Jordan Zemura, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. Udinese earn a corner.
38' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Maduka Okoye was alert and made an astonishing save!
37' Arthur Atta (Udinese) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
36' Keinan Davis (Udinese) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
36' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

35' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
31' Total attempts – 5:3. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
29' Mandela Keita (Parma) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
28' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
28' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Now Parma have a corner.
27' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) swings in a cross from the corner, but Edoardo Corvi reads it well and gathers the ball.
25' A dangerous looking corner kick from Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is cleared to safety by the defence.
23' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Parma will take a corner kick.
22' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
21' Patrick Cutrone (Parma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

20' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Marco Piccinini blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
18' Nicolo Bertola lays the ball off to Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z.
17' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 61:39.
15' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) plays a long ball to Patrick Cutrone, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
14' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) plays a one-two with Christian Kabasele, but the move breaks down.
13' The corner from Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is hurriedly cleared.
11' 0 - 1 GOAL! Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) scores easily from mid range after being presented with the ball on a golden platter after the goalkeeper slips. It’s 0:1.
10' Mandela Keita (Parma) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
8' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Enrico Del Prato (Parma) offside.
7' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
6' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.

6' Oumar Solet (Udinese) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Jesper Karlstrom was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
3' What a long-range shot by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.
2' The foul by Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) was seen by Marco Piccinini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
1' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
1' The first half has started.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Marco Piccinini will referee today's match.
